items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I noticed guys like Jonah Jones and Milt Henton and Keg Johnson and Hilton Jefferson, these guys, how they would run to the Western Union and send that money home first... But when I joined Cab, I watched the other guys in the band

ctx.x: He was the bass player with Jonah Jones.

Yeah, the bass player with Jonah Jones, Ivan Rolay. He used to give me hell all the time, but I ran up to him and I took it out and I showed it to him and I said, "I got it, I got it!" I was so proud, I said I was a man at last. And that next day, I was in tears -- I was in pain and everything else.
But that was my first experience of wanting to be a man, you know.
